name: qalatra
description: Personal task management system with Claude AI integration
author: Justin Handley

scripts.kill: pkill -9 -f 'Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron' 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 -f 'electron electron-main.js' 2>/dev/null; launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.qalatra.server 2>/dev/null; launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.qalatra.mcp 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :3456 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :3457 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.mcp: echo '⚠️  Standalone MCP (system Node). Do NOT use while Electron app is running — run npm run electron-dev instead, which manages MCP automatically. Run npm run rebuild:electron before restarting the app after this.' && npm run rebuild:node && node mcp/http-server.js
scripts.electron-dev: npm run kill && npm run rebuild:electron && sleep 1 && NODE_ENV=development concurrently --names vite,electron --prefix-colors green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix ui" "./node_modules/.bin/electron electron-main.js"
scripts.restart: npm run kill && sleep 1 && NODE_ENV=development ./node_modules/.bin/electron electron-main.js
scripts.build:mdpdf: npm run build:mdpdf --prefix ui && cp ui/dist-mdpdf/mdpdf.html server/static/mdpdf.html
scripts.build:terminal: npm run build:terminal --prefix ui && cp ui/dist-terminal/terminal.html server/static/terminal.html
scripts.start: npm run kill && sleep 1 && NODE_ENV=production ./node_modules/.bin/electron electron-main.js
scripts.ci:server: bash -n scripts/bootstrap-linux-server.sh scripts/install-linux-server.sh scripts/install-cloudflare-tunnel.sh && node --check server/index.js && node --check server/service-manager.js && node --check scripts/rebuild-node-native.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-server.mjs && npm run rebuild:node && npm run smoke:server
scripts.dist: npm run check-imports && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:publish: npm run check-imports && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish always
